paper_title: More Tokens, Lower Precision Towards the Optimal Token-Precision   Trade-off in KV Cache Compression
caption: The results of Layer-Wise Quantized Pruning on Mistral-7B-v0.2-Instruct, with SnapKV as pruning method. KV cache budget=1/64.
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the relative change in performance of different quantization methods at various layers of the Mistral-7B-v0.2-Instruct model. The x-axis is labeled 'Layer' and is linear, ranging from 'Layer1-4' to 'Layer29-32' with evenly spaced intervals at each layer. The y-axis is labeled 'Relative Change' and is also linear, with a range from -25% to 5%, including regular interval tick marks. There are four lines represented in the plot: the line for 'LB-Avg of 2×tokens,8-bit' is depicted in yellow with circular markers and a solid line, showing a steady change around 0% across layers; the 'LB-Avg of 1×tokens,16-bit' is shown in red with square markers and a solid line, starting around 0% and declining to approximately -5% at layers 5-12 before stabilizing; the 'RULER4k of 2×tokens,8-bit' is illustrated in light blue with circular markers and a solid line, showing a gradual increase from -5% at layers 5-12 to approximately 5% at the last layers; and the 'RULER4k of 1×tokens,16-bit' is presented in dark blue with square markers and a solid line, starting from around -15% and increasing to about 0% by layer 29-32. The dashed gray line represents the baseline of '4×tokens,4-bit', indicating the reference point at 0% relative change.
